name: CI

permissions:
  contents: read

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
    - main
    - v*-main

env:
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  CLICOLOR: 1
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
  RUST_TOOLCHAIN_STABLE: "1.99"  # STABLE

concurrency:
  group: "${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}"
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  ci:
    permissions:
      contents: none
    name: CI
    needs: [test, msrv, lockfile, docs, rustfmt, clippy, minimal-versions]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: "always()"
    steps:
      - name: Failed
        run: exit 1
        if: "contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') || contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled') || contains(needs.*.result, 'skipped')"
  test:
    name: Test
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: ["ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest"]
        rust: ["stable"]
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.rust != 'stable' }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      # Reduce amount of data cached
      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: line-tables-only
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Install Rust
      run: rustup update --no-self-update ${{ matrix.rust }} && rustup default ${{ matrix.rust }}
    - name: Initialize cache
      uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@d1527c8f67ef9af357290475d4af4b0fab8f12e0 # v2.9.3
    - name: Install cargo-hack
      uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32  # v2.88.0
      with:
        tool: cargo-hack
    - name: Build
      run: cargo test --workspace --no-run
    - name: Test
      run: cargo hack test --each-feature --skip debug --workspace
  miri:
    name: Miri
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      MIRIFLAGS: "-Zmiri-disable-isolation"
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Install Rust
      run: rustup update --no-self-update nightly && rustup default nightly
    - name: Install miri
      run: rustup component add miri
    - name: Initialize cache
      uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@d1527c8f67ef9af357290475d4af4b0fab8f12e0 # v2.9.3
    # no-default features is a subset, not needed
    # all-features is `debug` which is extremely slow
    - name: Default features
      run: cargo miri test --workspace
  msrv:
    name: "Check MSRV"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: ["ubuntu-latest"]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Install Rust
      run: rustup update --no-self-update stable && rustup default stable
    - name: Initialize cache
      uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@d1527c8f67ef9af357290475d4af4b0fab8f12e0 # v2.9.3
    - name: Install cargo-hack
      uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32  # v2.88.0
      with:
        tool: cargo-hack
    - name: Default features
      run: cargo hack check --each-feature --locked --rust-version --ignore-private --workspace --all-targets --keep-going

      matrix:

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
